notes.title: Eggcelerate! v1.3.11 Release Notes
notes.notes:
- Attempting to fix issue with black screen / game lock accessing Winter Eggspansion.
- If this fails, try uninstall then install again.

notes.title: Eggcelerate! v1.3.10 Release Notes
notes.notes: Fixed issue with missing trees on Winter Eggspansion levels.

notes.title: Eggcelerate! v1.1.2 Release Notes
notes.notes:
- Attempted fix of saving/loading issue causing game to relock itself.
- Fixed an issue with one of the hidden achievements.
- Added a few anticut areas to block off cutting the corners in 11, 14, 30
- Added colliders for some objects in level 30.
- Updated the developer times, this should be final times for these levels.
- Actual fix for time <= devTime as there were still issues in v1.1.1
- Fixed icon for dev time so it shows if the achievement was collected.
- Level select now remembers the last level played.
- Fixed issue with victory jumping to retry/exit after finish and still turning.
- Fixed an issue with Keep it Alive.
- Always show Keep it Alive icon in level 1.
- Fixed some pixel-noise on the Keep it Alive HUD icon.
- Added icons on Level Select to show there are more than 15 levels.
- Moved start line to ensure the timer restarts on reset on Track 25.
- Fixed unreported issue in the Credits scene.
- Fixing an issue that may have invoked achievement or saving issues.
- Fixed a hidden achievement.

notes.title: Release Notes for Eggcelerate! v1.1.1
notes.notes:
- Added pink and purple bunny bowls for Easter.
- Fixed steam achievements for 6 eggs, developer times and 1000 eggs dropped.
- Fixed in game achievement notification showing when the steam notification shows.
- Fixed small holes in the jump gap on Track 10.
- Fixed issue with spoon bowl sizing, it was hard to judge top of bowl.
- Fixed floor on the bus/van and peach RV rear door color.
- Fixed issue where RV and chicken-bowl were clipping on the Car Setup Screen.
- Fixed usability with cursor vs gamepad vs keyboard on some of the UI elements.
- Fixed issue where cursor would sit on a button and not highlight while moving.
- Added planks and haybales to direct focus into a windmill.
- Fixed stretched and moving textures on downhill levels.
- Fixed an issue where one of the hidden achievements was giving a different achievement ID.
- Fixed some cheesy "cuts".
- Fixed fade-out from the music that made the loop noticeable.
- Added a small egg to show when Keep it Alive is still valid in a run.
- Fixed issue with settings and paused screens on very wide displays.
